name: session-journal
description: Session journal, cross-session memory (store/recall), and Bash guardrails for Claude Code.

format_command.title: Format command
format_command.description: Optional. Shell command to format code (e.g. 'npm run format'). Runs at Stop; if it exits non-zero the turn is blocked until fixed. Leave empty to disable.

lint_command.title: Lint command
lint_command.description: Optional. Shell command to lint (e.g. 'npm run lint'). Runs at Stop; if it exits non-zero the turn is blocked until fixed. Leave empty to disable.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: Optional. Shell command to run tests (e.g. 'npm test'). Runs at Stop; if it exits non-zero the turn is blocked until fixed. Leave empty to disable.

auto_rollup.title: Auto session rollup
auto_rollup.description: Set to 'off' to disable the automatic end-of-session rollup note (files touched + edit count) written to memory. Enabled by default; a rollup is written only when the session made edits.
